page0.text:
"Three... What's your reply, Emiya?"
"AHHH!"
We stare at each other.
Did I just hear a scream coming from below...!?

page1.text:
"Tohsaka, that was..."
"...A scream, right?"
I immediately stand up and start running.
"Hey, do you know where it came from, Emiya...!?"
"How would I know! I could only tell it came from below!"
"Hold on, I'll lift the Bounded Field...!"

page2.text:
I run down the stairs.
"I said hold on! It's dangerous to go by yourself!"
"This isn't the time to be worrying! That scream sounded bad!"

page3.text:
"I know that! That's why I'm saying it's dangerous, stupid!"
I go down to the first floor.
At first glance, the hall looks empty.
But then I spot a female student laying on the floor at the far end.

page4.text:
No!
The student is in a heap in front of the emergency exit.

page5.text:
"...Good. She only passed out."
I run to the student to check if she's okay.
Is she a first year?
She's unconscious, but I don't see any bleeding or wounds, so she seems all right.

page6.text:
"It's more than that! She's so pale. Can't you tell that she's empty inside!?"
"Huh...? Empty inside...?"

page7.text:
"She's had her magical energy...her life force drained. It's as bad as—no, worse than those attacked by Caster.
This girl is going to die if we leave her like this."
"Wha... Die without a single wound...!?"

page8.text: "Even if there's no external wounds, it follows that she'd die if her life force is gone. She doesn't have enough bloodflow... Hold on, in this state, I might be able to do something with the stone I have..."

page9.text:
She rifles through her pockets.
...Thank god.
It seems serious, but Tohsaka seems to know how to cure her.

page10.text:
She kneels over and treats the collapsed student.
...
From her profile, she looks incredibly serious.
She tends to the student, as sweat forms on her forehead.

page11.text:
"Hm?"
...What is it...
It's...her expression is so laser-focused it pains me just to look at it.
I feel like...it isn't the first time I've seen—

page12.text:
"Ugh, that's so annoying...! Emiya, can you close that door? My hair keeps flying into my face."
"Huh... Oh, that emergency exit?"
I look at the open door.

page13.text:
"Huh...?"
Open...?
Come to think of it, we haven't even discovered why the girl collapsed in the first place.
It's not like she did this on her own. Someone obviously attacked her.
It didn't even take us a minute to get here, so if the culprit fled, it had to be out this door.

page14.text:
"Oh..."
Is it because I was looking in that direction?
I can just make out something dark flying in our direction—
"Watch out, Tohsaka!"
I shield Tohsaka with my right arm.

page15.text:
"Huh... W-what is that...! Emiya, y-your arm...!"
"Hrrk...!"
A shadowy dagger has pierced right through my arm.

page16.text:
Protruding from between my elbow and wrist is something that resembles a nail.
No, it's far too large to be just a nail.
And whatever it is, it has completely skewered my forearm.

page17.text:
"Why did you... I mean, y-you're bleeding so much, but it d-doesn't hurt...?"
"...It hurts. It hurts like crazy."
But it hurts so much that I can't panic.
More importantly...
It looks like this thing was aimed at Tohsaka's head.

page18.text:
"...Tohsaka, take care of her."
I get ready to run.
There's no time to wait for her response.
With my left hand, I adjust the grip on the metal pipe I'd Strengthened earlier and fly out the emergency exit.

page19.text:
"Haah...haah haah haah..."
My right arm dangles as I run.
Everything below the elbow is red from blood.
...Is it just bad luck with limbs for me today?
Tohsaka tells me to hand over one hand with the Command Spells on it, and now my other hand is partially severed from the rest of me.

page20.text:
"Ugh... It has to be around here."
I look around.
Though I don't know who or what did this, I can feel them drawing me out.
Whoever attacked that female student...
Whatever attacked Tohsaka with that dagger is nearby.
I haven't lost them yet.
If I close my eyes, I can feel the dark magical energy moving.

page21.text:
"Behind the archery range... In the woods...!"
I jump over the fence and run across mossy ground.
Then...
Between the trees...
Concealed amongst the thicket, a familiar face takes one look at me and laughs.

page22.text:
"Shinji...?"
I stop without thinking.
Just what is he doing here?
He's supposed to be missing. Wait, no...
Mitsuzuri is the one that's missing, Shinji's the last one who saw her, and...

page23.text:
"...Hrrk!!!!!"
My injured arm throbs.
The moment I'm about to fall forward...
A nail-like dagger is thrust at my throat.

page24.text:
"Hnng...!"
I manage to dodge.
Instead of going backwards or sideways, I follow my tumbling body and roll forward to avoid the blow.

page25.text:
"Hnng... Guh...!!!"
My throat.
It scraped my throat. My skin's cut.
Even then, I'm lucky.
If I had been any slower, it would've cut through bone and sinew.

page26.text:
"You...!"
I scramble up.
In front of me...
Stands a smiling woman clothed in black.

page27.text:
"A Servant...!"
I don't even have to check.
A concentration of magical energy far beyond that of a human. Not even Tohsaka compares.
I don't know what class she is, but her spiritual presence is greater than a human, without a doubt—

page28.text:
"She disappeared...!?"
The shadow vanishes from my vision.
Instinctively, I can feel death's swift approach.
I desperately swing my weapon above my head.

page29.text:
"Guh...!"
The rod is able to repel the nail coming at my head from above.
I don't know if she's somehow related to a spider or something, but she's leaping and clinging to the trees like one.

page30.text:
...
I run.
It must've been chance that I was able to block that.
There's no way I'll be able to dodge another, and fleeing is out of the question.

page31.text:
"Ungh, haah...!"
I make it to a nearby tree and put it to my back.
That's one direction that I should be safe from. Or so I have to believe if I have any chance at this.

page32.text:
"Damn it... Even though she's wearing something that stands out that much, why can't I..."
I don't see the Servant in black anywhere.
She might be jumping from branch to branch, since she hasn't come down to the ground at all.

page33.text:
...
Sweat rolls down my forehead.
I can hear the sound of jangling chains. It's like the rattle of a snake ready to strike.

page34.text:
"Ha... Haha..."
Under the tree, I try my best to suppress mirthless laughter.
The sound of chains echo through the woods.
In this life-and-death situation where the next attack is sure to kill me, my mind is blank.
I have no sense of time. The guillotine just hangs in the air.

page35.text:
"Ha... Ha ha."
That's what's strange.
The battle should be over by now.

page36.text:
But I'm still alive.
How strange... Maybe that last attack killed me and my mind is now blank from wanting to believe that my fear of a surprise attack is actually a posthumous dream.

page37.text:
"...Saber."
...I can't compete against a Servant by myself.
Then I'll have to rely on her.
Command Spells. If I use a Command Spell and call Saber, I should be able to get out of this predicament.

page38.text:
But...can I?
I'm the one who got myself into this death trap. Then, I should be the one to handle it. And most of all...

page39.text:
"...I haven't exhausted all of my options."
That's right.
I have a weapon in my hand, even if it's a shoddy one.
And I can still move.
If the location is bad, I can just move.
I can call for Saber after that—

page40.text:
"I'm surprised. You're not using your Command Spell?"
"...!"
The voice echoes.
Above... So she was hiding up in the tree.

page41.text:
"...Heh. Unfortunately, I don't have that many left. If I use one over something like this, I don't know what I'd do moving forward."
And well, to be honest, I don't really know how to use it either.

page42.text:
"...I see. You must be brave, unlike my Master."
I search for her exact location.
Where is her voice coming from...?

page43.text:
"Then, I shall also change my strategy. I cannot go all out against a Master without a Servant... I shall gently kill you."
...The voice goes silent.
Only the sound of chains echoes through the woods.

page44.text:
...
...She's coming.
What I have to do is get out of these woods.
But to do so, I would have to block this Servant's nail weapon multiple times.

page45.text:
"..."
The fact that I only have the leg of a chair that I Strengthened to defend myself is so pathetic that it's funny.
If at least...
If only this thing was impressive like his blades, then I could not only block but even counterattack...

page46.text:
"...
...
Let's go."
...I don't have the time to be thinking about what-ifs.
It's about thirty meters to get out of the woods.
This isn't much compared to the chase I had with Tohsaka...!

page47.text:
I run.
I ignore the harsh sound of chains and run frantically towards the exit...!

page48.text:
"Hup...!"
I repel the attack from above.
Then I block the roundhouse kick from the Servant that landed on the ground to my left.
She's in front of me now.
I think she's getting irritated from having her blows blocked, but I manage to deflect another onslaught...!

page49.text:
"Ugh... This just isn't...!?"
The Servant in black retreats.

page50.text:
...
It's just chance.
Just like the first attack, blocking everything else has been because of fortunate happenstance.
I can't even see the enemy.
For someone like that to be able to survive, it is nothing but pure luck.

page51.text:
But...
Is it really that common?
No, what if my assumptions were wrong in the first place?
The first attack.
A surprise attack to my head.
Such attacks that would be impossible for Shirou Emiya to dodge...
There's no way that coincidence is lining up this much...

page52.text:
"...You..."
The Servant in black mutters to herself.
A surprisingly beautiful, sensual voice, despite the irritation evident in it.

page53.text:
"Hah, you suck. You lack power compared to the other Servants...!"
I swing at the Servant standing in my way.
"Khh...!"
The Servant in black blocks my blow and jumps back, her hair flowing in her wake.

page54.text:
"I can do it...!"
There's nothing in my way now.
The Servant in black retreated.
If I just keep going just a few more meters like this...

page55.text:
"...This is the end.
From the very beginning, you've been dancing to my tune."

page56.text:
"Huh...?"
My body falls.
Rather, I'm being pulled backwards.
My right arm hurts.
Some unknown force is dragging my skewered arm back...!?

page57.text:
"Do you still not understand? The object stabbing your arm is my nail."
"Your nail...!?"

page58.text:
That makes me realize.
Extending from her weapon...
The grating sound of metal against metal...
The sound of chains...
I've been hearing them ever since leaving that doorway and—

page59.text:
"Shi—!"
I reach out for my right arm with my left hand, but it's too late.
Dragged by some invisible force, my arm flies up and out of reach.

page60.text:
"Guh...!!! Agh...!"
With no mercy to my agony, it lifts me into the air...
The nail piercing my arm is attached to a chain.
The chain extends up into the canopy, using a branch as a fulcrum, and leaving me strung up by it.

page61.text:
"Agh... Guh...!"
"...Well then. You said something interesting earlier."
...The Servant in black approaches.
I can't run away or fight now that I'm suspended in the air.

page62.text:
"You said that I am inferior to other Servants.
This is most troubling. I must correct this mistaken perception before I can slay you."
...I'm like a sacrifice.
It's like I've been sent to the gallows in a Western.

page63.text:
The nail-like dagger is raised.
The Servant in black licks the tip of it.
"Let me see. First, I shall take those mistaken eyes.
Then your remaining limbs afterwards."
She makes a nimble jump and appears right before me, suspended three meters in the air.

page64.text:
...
The nail is swung downwards.
My body can still move.
I...
